title: mimid: interop driver sent the current epoch's tree as a full RatchetTreeOption with the next epoch's GroupInfo
description: Found 2026-11-17 against local mimi-hubd fdce222 (namespace run, tools/interop/haven/live). The B4 driver's commit_request built RatchetTreeOption::full from member.ratchet_tree() before merge_pending_commit, i.e. the current epoch's tree, beside the Full GroupInfo of the epoch after the Commit. ratchet-tree-options-02 §3: the tree goes with the GroupInfo. mimi-hubd ffd9e24+ seeds a room's tree from the pair (PublicGroup::from_external) and logged '<room> stays untracked: its GroupInfo and tree are not a valid group' for steps 4b and 4f. mimi-mls had no accessor for the pending Commit's tree. Fix: Member::pending_ratchet_tree (55a863d, test crates/mimi-mls/tests/member_pending_tree.rs: pending tree != current, == tree after merge; error with nothing pending) and the driver uses it (095e1c9); after the fix the hub's only refusal to seed is 'a participant the hub lists is not in its tree' (dave, listed without a client, step 4a), which is correct. mimid's own hub ignores the client's tree (decision mimid-1wgh.6.12), so nothing else was affected; the mimid-server test helper tests/common/update.rs passes a tree the hub never reads.
